full_judgment: 3. The defendant No.1 submitted a written statement contending inter alia, that Maqbul Ahmed acquired the land by purchase and that thereafter constructed rice-mill, saw-mill upon the said land and that said Maqbul Ahmed being in possession died leaving behind three sons named Nazibar Rahman, Matiur Rahman and the defendant No.2, Delwar Rahman and 2 daughters named Majeda Khatun, the defendant No.1 and Sajeda Khatun. The sons and daughter of Maqbul Ahmed transferred 3(three) decimals of land in favour' of his cousin brother named Abul Kashem, Abul Kalam and Abul Hossain and that after the said transfer the sons and daughters of Maqbul. Ahmed had 10 decimals of land, which .is the schedule-Ka land to the plaint. Nazibar Rahman transferred his share by an oral gift in favour of the defendant No.2 and that thereafter the said transfer was confirmed by swearing an affidavit on 1712.1997. The defendant No.2 transferred his share by a kabala deed dated 8.2.1998 in favour of the defendant No.l. The D.P. Khatian was prepared in the name of the defendant No.2 No oral gift was made in favour of the plaintiff as alleged.
